items.title: Plastic waste burning trial at cement factory prompts backlash
items.description: A major cement manufacturer has been allowed to burn more plastic waste for fuel at its Adelaide site in a decision a local council is seeking to challenge in court.

items.title: India's 'cockroach' movement supporters caned by police
items.description: Thousands of supporters of India's youth-led "cockroach" movement gathered in the New Delhi to march ‌on parliament seeking the resignation of the education minister, despite police denying permission for the protest.

items.title: Author Randa Abdel-Fattah sues Bendigo Writers Festival organisers
items.description: Randa Abdel-Fattah launches legal action after Bendigo Writers Festival organisers sent a code of conduct that sparked censorship concerns and led to the boycott of dozens of authors.

items.title: 'ISIS bride' Rayann El Houli granted bail by Melbourne court
items.description: A woman facing terror charges after living under Islamic State rule in Syria will be freed on bail, after being in custody for two months.

items.title: 'Good night, sweet dreams': Jacki Weaver leads farewells at Derryn Hinch state funeral
items.description: Broadcaster Ray Martin, Australian actress Jacki Weaver and performer Rhonda Burchmore are among the entertainment heavyweights to pay tribute to Derryn Hinch at his state funeral service.

items.title: Quadruplets born in Brisbane 'one of the rarest births in the world'
items.description: A Queensland family has grown by four after an extremely rare pregnancy with identical quadruplets all sharing one placenta.

items.title: Labor MP calls for exclusion zones at synagogues akin to abortion clinics
items.description: Former attorney-general Mark Dreyfus has pushed for more robust social media moderation and protest laws at the Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion.

items.title: The 13 photos that summed up the chaos of the 2026 World Cup final
items.description: It was magical chaos from start to finish as Spain claimed victory in the 2026 World Cup final. Here are the 13 photos that summed it up.

items.title: US launches further strikes on Iran as Tehran attacks oil tankers
items.description: The US launches a new round of air strikes on Iran after announcing the death of another American service member, and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps says it has immobilised two oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: 'Every working Australian' exposed to private credit risk as ASIC raises alarm
items.description: The corporate regulator is concerned about the risks posed by private credit for Australians with superannuation.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
